description: Shared Slack plugin utilities and configuration for OpenClaw, including manifest building, setup instructions, account configuration checks, and plugin creation.

methods.name: buildSlackManifest
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing the Slack app manifest based on the bot name.

methods.name: buildSlackSetupLines
methods.description: Provides setup instructions and the manifest JSON for configuring Slack integration.

methods.name: setSlackChannelAllowlist
methods.description: Enables specified channels in the Slack allowlist for a given account configuration.

methods.name: isSlackPluginAccountConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a Slack plugin account has the necessary tokens and secrets configured based on mode.

methods.name: isSlackSetupAccountConfigured
methods.description: Verifies if both bot and app tokens are configured for a Slack account.

methods.name: createSlackPluginBase
methods.description: Creates a Slack plugin object with capabilities, commands, prompts, and configuration schema.
